about_the_game:
Baby Formula is a charming couch co-op game where you and your friends become a group of determined babies set on performing household chores. With adults glued to their screens, the cake-baking, lawn-mowing, and tire-changing duties fall into the tiny, clumsy hands of the babies.

Steering these lovable ragdolls isn't easy. These pint-sized pranksters stumble around, making it tricky to coordinate your own actions, let alone work together with your teammates. You'll aim to pour cream into a bowl only to watch it splatter on the floor. The lawn mower might trim the flowerbed instead of the grass. Avoid putting screwdrivers into electrical outlets! But with teamwork and a bit of luck, you might just follow the to-do list and set a new high score. It’s messy, it’s janky, and it’s hilariously fun! If you love ragdoll physics and cooperative chaos, Baby Formula is the game for you.

                          

These cute little troublemakers love to play with water, electricity, and other risky items, but don’t worry – they’re safe from harm!

                          

The more you try to keep things tidy, the messier it gets. Liquids love to spread across the floor, creating a delightful chaos!

                          

After a fun-filled day of chores, your little angels will inevitably doze off in the sandbox, dreaming of the next big adventure!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual core 2.8 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 512 MB
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad core 3GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2 GB

short_description: Gather your friends and guide a team of mischievous babies as they tackle household tasks like baking, washing the car, or mowing the lawn. Carry and drag objects, solve physics puzzles, and try not to make a mess (you will definitely make a mess). Try to finish before daddy's done doomscrolling!
